title: A specific promise for a creator lesson
brief: Test one headline on an owned content lesson preview. Keep layout, content, CTA and distribution fixed. Measure one Continue action per identity. This demonstration uses synthetic traffic.
hypothesis: Visitors assigned an outcome-specific headline will click Continue more often than those assigned a generic headline. Synthetic traffic verifies the measurement flow; a real audience test would be needed to validate this preference.
treatment: Turn one idea into a video outline
